profile.headline: BSCS student & web developer
profile.tagline: Building useful things for the web.
profile.intro: I’m a BSCS student and developer in the making. I turn ideas into thoughtful, responsive web experiences while building strong foundations in computer science.
bio: I’m currently studying for a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS) at GU Tech. My education began at Iqra Huffaz Boys School and continued at Fatmiyah Boys College.
I enjoy building with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and I’m also studying Python, C and C++. Each project helps me connect what I learn in class with practical problem solving.

My current focus is on programming fundamentals, data structures and algorithms as I work toward becoming a thoughtful software engineer. I’m also exploring artificial intelligence and learning databases and backend development.

projects.title: FocusFlow
projects.summary: A focused task planner with a working Pomodoro timer, task states and browser storage.
projects.description:
FocusFlow is a calm, single-page task planner built to make room for deep work. It pairs a simple task list with a working Pomodoro timer so planning and focusing happen in the same place.

What it does

  • Add, complete and remove tasks with clear task states
  • Run focus and break sessions with a Pomodoro timer
  • Keeps your tasks in the browser with Local Storage — no account needed

What I practised

DOM manipulation, timers and intervals in JavaScript, persisting state with Local Storage, and building a clean responsive layout with CSS.

coverImage.alt: FocusFlow task planner with Pomodoro timer (screenshot of the live demo)

projects.title: BudgetWise
projects.summary: Track income and spending with category filters, monthly summaries and persistent transactions.
projects.description:
BudgetWise is a personal finance tracker that makes money a little clearer. Record income and expenses, filter by category and see a monthly summary at a glance.

What it does

  • Add income and expense transactions with categories
  • Filter transactions and see monthly totals and savings
  • Visual summary chart of spending
  • Transactions persist in the browser

What I practised

Working with arrays of data, filtering and aggregating values, rendering simple charts with HTML and CSS, and form handling in JavaScript.

coverImage.alt: BudgetWise monthly overview with income, expenses and balance (screenshot of the live demo)

projects.title: CoursePilot
projects.summary: A practical student planner for assignment deadlines, course progress and recorded grades.
projects.description:
CoursePilot is a student planner built around a real semester: courses, upcoming deadlines, progress and grades in one place. Add your own courses and make it yours.

What it does

  • Add courses and assignments with due dates
  • Track semester progress
  • Record grades per course
  • Everything is stored locally in your browser

What I practised

Structuring related data, date handling, building reusable UI patterns and keeping a multi-section interface organised.

coverImage.alt: CoursePilot student workspace with assignment planner and course progress (screenshot of the live demo)

projects.title: AH Clothing Hub
projects.summary: A live online clothing store for Pakistan — men, women and unisex collections, search, wishlist and cash-on-delivery ordering.
projects.description:
AH Clothing Hub is a real, deployed e-commerce store based in Karachi that delivers across Pakistan. It pairs classic eastern elegance with clean, modern cuts and is built to feel like a premium fashion brand.

What it does

  • Shop by category — Men, Women and Unisex wear, New In and Sale
  • Product search, product detail pages, quick add and wishlist
  • Seasonal hero slideshow, new arrivals, featured and on-sale sections
  • Customer accounts, order tracking, returns & exchange and FAQ pages
  • Cash on Delivery, JazzCash and EasyPaisa payments; free delivery above Rs. 5,000
  • WhatsApp chat and a newsletter sign-up

What I practised

Building a production storefront with Next.js, optimised images served from Cloudinary, deployment on Vercel, and designing a shopping experience for local payment and delivery needs.

coverImage.alt: AH Clothing Hub storefront home page with winter collection hero (screenshot of the live site)

projects.title: GU TECH LMS Portal
projects.summary: A full-stack Learning Management System with courses, assignments, timed quizzes, grading and role-based access.
projects.description:
GU TECH LMS is a responsive internal Learning Management System. Authenticated operations run through a server API, PostgreSQL row level security protects the data, and Supabase Storage keeps course materials private.

What it does

  • Admin, teacher and student roles with admin-approved student registration
  • Courses, modules, lessons and private resources
  • Assignments, submissions, grading and CSV gradebook export
  • One-attempt timed quizzes scored on the server
  • Announcements, marks, classroom chat, complaints and profile management
  • Audit records, rate limits and password recovery

What I practised

Designing a secure full-stack app: React + Vite front end, Node.js/Express API with authorization middleware, Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL migrations and row level security policies.

projects.title: Periodic Table
projects.summary: The full periodic table of elements laid out with pure HTML and CSS, colour-coded by element category.
projects.description:
A beginner-friendly Periodic Table of Elements built using only HTML and CSS, laid out like the real table.

What it does

  • Complete layout including the lanthanoids and actinoids
  • Atomic number, symbol and name for every element
  • Different colours for each element category
  • No JavaScript required

What I practised

Semantic HTML structure, CSS grid layout and organising a large, data-heavy page cleanly.

projects.title: Simple Calculator
projects.summary: An interactive calculator for everyday arithmetic with a clean, friendly interface.
projects.description:
A simple and interactive calculator built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

What it does

  • Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
  • Percentages and brackets
  • Clear and reset

What I practised

Handling button events in JavaScript, evaluating expressions safely and styling a compact UI with CSS.

coverImage.alt: Simple Calculator interface with keypad (screenshot of the live demo)
